final_message:
I've written the deviation report as `clause-rules-deviation-report.docx`. It compares MSA s. 14.2 (and related ss. 12, 14.1, 14.3, 15) with the SAI Rules 2022 across 13 issues; it passes `validate.py` and parse-doc reads it back correctly.
Critical: 90-day award deadline, damages exclusion that drops the s. 12.2 carve-outs, and server-log preservation (emergency arbitrator available; June logs may already be deleted). High: escalation/notice condition precedent, 15-day appointment window, dual language, perpetual confidentiality, discovery limit. Moderate: sole arbitrator, own-costs rule, 2022 Edition lock. Low: appeal waiver, NY/Singapore split. The report also answers Kuiper's Oct 28 positions, corrects eight memo premises, and sets out a dated pre-filing plan.
